title: mail-server: MemoryBackend Email copy skips counts
description: Found in JMAP-p36f. MemoryBackend::copy_object for Email creates/extends the Thread in the target account but does not update the target Mailboxes' totalEmails/unreadEmails/totalThreads/unreadThreads (RFC 8621 2) or the Message-ID index, and duplicates the Thread step instead of using Inner::insert_email (added in JMAP-p36f). Fix: route the Email branch of copy_object through Inner::insert_email.
close_reason: batch 22: implemented, adversarially verified, CI green at 20645f57, pushed
